water_treatment.name: Water Treatment Plant
water_treatment.idea: Supplies clean water to 15,000 residents per plant; without it, dense zones cap out and health drops.

water_tower.name: Water Tower
water_tower.idea: Stores pumped water and keeps pressure up for 6,000 residents nearby; cheap, but needs a water plant upstream.

wind_farm.name: Wind Farm
wind_farm.idea: Clean power, 300 units, zero pollution; output varies with wind, coastal/plains bonus, turbines annoy adjacent homes (noise).

solar_farm.name: Solar Farm
solar_farm.idea: Clean power, 250 units by day and none at night; zero pollution, cheap upkeep, desert/low-cloud regions give a bonus.

hydro_dam.name: Hydroelectric Dam
hydro_dam.idea: Clean power, 800 units, must be placed across a river; floods the upstream tiles into a reservoir that boosts nearby land value.

landfill.name: Landfill
landfill.idea: Absorbs 20 tons/month of city garbage; cheap but polluting and smelly (land value drop nearby), fills up and becomes a park when capped.

recycling_center.name: Recycling Center
recycling_center.idea: Diverts 40% of garbage from landfills and earns a little income from sold materials; needs road access and creates light traffic.

data_center.name: Data Center
data_center.idea: High-tech jobs and +tax income, attracts commercial growth; draws heavy power and water, very low pollution, needs fiber/education.

space_center.name: Space Center
space_center.idea: Prestige landmark: big tourism and high-tech industry boost, rare launch events; needs a large budget, power and an airport nearby.
